name: When should I call a professional water damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional water damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional water damage restoration company as soon as possible after discovering water damage, especially if the damage is significant, involves sewage, or has been present for more than 24-48 hours. Professionals have specialized equipment to thoroughly dry affected areas, prevent mold growth, and safely address contamination. Prompt intervention by experts minimizes secondary damage, reduces repair costs, and ensures a healthier living environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call professionals immediately for significant damage, sewage issues, or if water has been present for over 24-48 hours.
